# Rule tags and their implementations (generated by tools/map/gen.py; do not edit)

This lexical index includes design tags cited in comments (`D25.3`, `B9`, `PR-B1`, `C-4`) and quoted UPPER_SNAKE strings, including diagnostic codes. A match is not necessarily a rule. **Before changing an actual rule, change it in every layer listed for it**, or know why not. Ownership layers: lower, ir, codegen, ownership-runtime, sparrow.

## Exclusions when reading this index as a rule map

The following matches are not design or verifier rules; exclude them from rule-duplication reviews:

- Token kind names in `okkama-compiler/src/syntax/token.rs` (for example `AMP_AMP`, `DOT_DOT`, `STREAM_WRITE`).
- Environment/build settings: `BLADE_OKKAMA`, `CARGO_*`, `GH09_LOOKUP_N`, `GIT_*`, `LC_ALL`, `NO_COLOR`, `NUMBER_OF_PROCESSORS`, `OKKAMA_*`, `SPARROW_*`, `SSL_CERT_DIR`, `SSL_CERT_FILE`.
- TLS suite names: `CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256`, `CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA384`, `SSL_NULL_WITH_NULL_NULL`.
- SQLite provider failure codes (`SQLITE_*`): runtime diagnostics, not compiler/verifier rules.
